lifecycle.description: refuse a second resident root inside a Grove instance
effects: Reads the Grove instance containing the new root and the live canvas roots.

lifecycle.description: label a newly born resident Grove root with its node id
effects: Sets owner=<node id> on the Grove instance containing the new root.

lifecycle.description: finish Grove instances owned by the closing node
effects: Finishes every Grove instance labeled owner=<closing node id> when its work is landed.
